title: dictyophleba stipulosa
intro: Dictyophleba stipulosa, commonly known as the bitter kola, is a tropical plant native to West Africa. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Dictyophleba stipulosa include treating respiratory issues, fever reduction, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
